title: Tune the circuit to the 1 kHz tone
story: A series RLC circuit picks out one tone: at resonance the inductor's and capacitor's reactances cancel and the whole signal reaches the 20 ohm resistor. The coil is fixed at 10 mH. Choose the capacitor so the circuit lets a 1 kHz tone through (within 3 dB) while a 3 kHz tone is cut by at least 10 dB.

goals.label: the 1 kHz tone passes within 3 dB
a 3 kHz tone is cut by at least 10 dB

hints: Resonance: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)). Solve for C: C = 1 / ((2 pi f0)^2 L).
With L = 10 mH and f0 = 1 kHz the exact value is about 2.5 uF.
